title: The induced morphism on fibres in a cartesian square with etale vertical arrows is etale
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Given a commutative square of schemes whose two vertical arrows are etale, and a point of the upper right scheme mapping to a point of the lower right one, the lemma asserts that the induced morphism of fibres over those points is etale (statement lines 8185-8196). The proof proceeds in three steps, each using a different standard fact. The base change of the upper left vertical arrow to the fibre of the lower right vertical arrow is etale because etale morphisms are stable under base change (proof lines 8198-8200); the fibre of an etale morphism over a point is a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable field extensions, and the chosen point of the upper right scheme is one of those summands, which makes the fibre over that point an open and closed subscheme of the previous one (proof lines 8200-8205); the composite of an open immersion with an etale morphism is etale, giving the conclusion (proof lines 8205-8208). The claim is H2: no step is a restatement of the conclusion, and in particular the middle step requires identifying the relevant fibre as one of the summands of a disjoint union of spectra of separable extensions, which is the point of the lemma.
